title: Women’s Appreciation
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office deals with a flasher incident when Phyllis is flashed in the parking lot, prompting concern and the formation of an anti-flashing task force led by Dwight. Meanwhile, Dwight issues a controversial memo restricting women's dress and behavior, which leads Michael to call a women's appreciation meeting to address sexism and misogyny. Jim reveals his six-month relationship with Karen, and Michael struggles with his complicated relationship with Jan. The episode explores themes of workplace safety, gender dynamics, and personal relationships, with moments of humor and tension throughout.
